metadata.scenario: A caller inquires about the types of pet grooming services available for large breed dogs. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Charles Thompson. I have a quick question about pet grooming services for my dog. Oh, I’m sorry, Charles, but we don’t offer pet grooming services. Really? I thought you might have some information or recommendations. Unfortunately, our focus is on home healthcare services. Got it. I should have checked first. No worries! Do you have any other questions about our services? Well, I’m still recovering from my surgery, and I’d like to know more about ongoing wound care. Of course! We provide skilled nursing care for wound management. How often would that typically be scheduled? It’s usually one to two visits per week, depending on your needs. That sounds good. Is there any cost associated with that? Yes, skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 per visit. And what does that include? It includes medication management, wound assessment, and health monitoring. Perfect, I’d like to schedule that. I can set that up for you. What days work best for you? I’m available on weekdays, preferably mornings. Great! I’ll get our nurse Robert to visit. Just to confirm, he’s available, right? Yes, Robert is available Tuesday through Saturday. Sounds good. Can you ensure he’s aware of my situation? Absolutely! I’ll brief him on your case and recovery. Thank you. I really appreciate that. Not a problem at all. Is there anything else I can assist you with? Actually, I need some detailed progress reports for the VA as well. We can definitely provide those. I’ll make a note for our nursing staff. Thank you! That would be really helpful. You’re welcome, Charles. I’ll follow up with you after the first visit. Sounds good. Thank you for your help today! You’re very welcome! Have a great day! You too, Margaret! Goodbye. Goodbye!
